item.title: Quick Take — Veridical Data Science (audiobook)
item.description: This book is about practicing data science in a way that is genuinely trustworthy. The central argument is that getting useful, reliable results from data requires more than applying algorithms — it requires critical thinking, domain knowledge, and a principled framework for evaluating whether your results hold up. The authors call this veridical, meaning truthful, data science.
